answer_summary: The git history in step3_evaluation.patch.log records three commits across an 22-minute window on 2026-10-01 for ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/tests/step-3-evaluation.json. Commit fd56cef introduced format_version 1, combining evaluation heuristics from historical/evaluation-tests.md and 31 TSR tests (tests 2–32, totaling 160 test cases) from tests/step-3-test-return-schema.md, but contained a JSON syntax termination error. Commit f0425b0 immediately repaired the JSON syntax closure. Commit fcb4522 executed an intentional wholesale heuristic restructuring—superseding format_version 1 with format_version 2—which converted the flat markdown-derived 'key_value_records' into structured JSON fields (purpose_and_scope, core_question, worked_examples, worked_test_required_coverage_reduced, procedural_instructions) while leaving the TSR test suite completely unaltered with zero incremental test case additions.

historical_facts.statement: Commit fd56cefbf20add524bf53b5e88463f5c9893ea17 (AuthorDate 2026-10-01T13:26:38-07:00, commit message 'Add merged Step 3 evaluation heuristic and question corpus') created ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/tests/step-3-evaluation.json with format_version 1, evaluation_heuristic.key_value_records (69 records), and step3_tsr containing 31 test groups (numbered 2 through 32, totaling 160 cases).

In commit fd56cefbf20add524bf53b5e88463f5c9893ea17, the single-line JSON ended with '}]}}' instead of closing the 'tests' array with an additional bracket '}]}]}}', resulting in a JSON parse error at character position 42294.

Commit f0425b0d40c5c3bb082feea78616d13546c992a5 (AuthorDate 2026-10-01T13:32:42-07:00, commit message 'Fix merged Step 3 evaluation JSON closure') modified the line ending to '}]}]}}', producing valid JSON without altering any text or test contents.

Commit fcb4522f6ce154bedeb7d197f3cf22ea3f5c694f (AuthorDate 2026-10-01T13:48:47-07:00, commit message 'Replace blemished Step 3 evaluation with evaluator revision') changed format_version from 1 to 2, replaced key_value_records with structured sections (purpose_and_scope, core_question, worked_examples, worked_test_required_coverage_reduced, procedural_instructions), and kept step3_tsr identical.

Both format_version 1 and format_version 2 cite the identical source paths and blob SHAs: evaluation_method_heuristic at ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/historical/evaluation-tests.md (blob_sha 613468ac6ff5e054c1268c50bc3710d36df8f3cd) and step3_tsr_question_list at ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/tests/step-3-test-return-schema.md (blob_sha 2c6e89baafd463579a341e4f3102b852e6e78ace).

historical_facts.statement: The step3_tsr property across all commits comprises tests 2 through 32 with exactly 160 case pairs; no test cases were incrementally added, removed, or renumbered between commit fd56cef and commit fcb4522.

interpretations.statement: The evolution of step-3-evaluation.json did not involve iterative or incremental test case additions. Instead, the test suite (Step 3 TSR) was imported wholesale in a complete state, and the evolution was characterized by representation refactoring: fixing a packaging syntax defect and then restructuring the heuristic from raw line-dump key-value pairs into a clean domain schema.

Commit fcb4522 represents an intentional supersession of format_version 1. The commit message 'Replace blemished Step 3 evaluation with evaluator revision' explicitly characterizes the initial representation as blemished, motivating the migration to format_version 2 where heuristic markdown tables were parsed into first-class JSON objects without altering the underlying contract rules.

The substantive Step 3 evaluation criteria remained continuous across all three commits. All 16 worked examples, the set-reduction test definition (sets D, R, C), 6 matching cases (M1–M6), 8 boundary cases (N1–N8), 6-step unfamiliar case evaluation procedure, and 5-step usage procedure were retained verbatim in content during the restructure from key_value_records to format_version 2.

truth_decisions.statement: Step 3 TSR evaluation criteria were established in commit fd56cefbf20add524bf53b5e88463f5c9893ea17 and remained untouched in content across subsequent revisions.

An intentional supersession of the initial evaluation heuristic format occurred in commit fcb4522f6ce154bedeb7d197f3cf22ea3f5c694f, replacing the raw markdown statement dump format with a structured schema revision.
Test cases were added incrementally across multiple commits in the Step 3 evaluation file.

unresolved_questions: Why Test 1 is absent from step3_tsr (the tests begin at test 2 and run through test 32) is not explained in the commit messages or diffs of step3_evaluation.patch.log.
